lines.text: The Admire races.
Altruia fires a beam toward the rushing ship.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: I'll stop it!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: You've got this!
Noah creates a shield to stop the beam.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Ugh...! The blast is so strong...!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Want me to switch in for you?

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: And how exactly would you do that?!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: I could throw my body in front of it...

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: You'd barely block anything like that! Just focus on shooting!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Okay.
Aboard the Admire, Neon and Noah throw themselves into the battle with Altruia.
Noah blocks all the beams, and Neon fires her bullets.
The Admire's machine guns unleash an endless rain of bullets, but not a single one reaches the towering false saint.
Her shields, as large as her own imposing form, block all attacks.
*Boom!*
The charging ship's hull rocks.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: Armor destroyed from R-041 to R-056.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Eeek...! Our ship...!
The Admire continues onward.
Altruia continues to create shields along the Admire's route.
The Admire keeps smashing the shields.
Its armor gradually reaches its limit.
Yet it continues to charge forward.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Helm! I hate to break it to you, but at this rate we're going to fall apart before we get a shot off! Haha!

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: This is the only way. We have to fire the Aegis Cannon from the shortest distance possible.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: If we want to pierce those shields and damage her, this is our only choice.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Aye! Everyone dreams of a close-quarters battle at sea!

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: But does that mean we have to just keep moving forward and getting hit?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: We have Noah. Let's trust her.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Feel free to trust me just a little less, would ya?!
As Noah blocks attack after attack, her nose starts bleeding again.
Neon gazes at her.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Why're you staring?! Enjoying the view?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Yeah. I think you're cool.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Wh-what're you talking about?!
Neon wipes Noah's blood with her sleeve.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Why'd you do that? Gross!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: You're really cool right now.

lines.speaker: anchor_op_r
lines.text: Um... High energy detected from Altruia.
The countless hands sprouting from Altruia begin to move.
The hands stop their aimless movements and join in prayer.
The black star at the center of Altruia begins to gleam and float.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Something big is coming...!

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Ugh... I hate that attack!

lines.speaker: helm_op_l
lines.text: Everyone! Brace for impact!

lines.speaker: mast_op_r
lines.text: It's going to hit us head on! A little help please! Noah!

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Yeah, I got it!
*Boom!*
The black star explodes.
Light shoots up.
It begins to spread out around Altruia.
It spreads, looking as if it wants to consume everything around it.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Ugh! This is too much for someone who just woke up!
Noah's shields become one. They gleam in the shape of Eden's emblem.
They stop the light rushing toward the Admire's bow.
*Rumble!*
The Admire shakes like mad.
Everyone is inside the light.
It's nearly blinding.
Inside that light, Neon looks at Noah's form, which is shining even more brightly.
She watches Noah use every bit of strength left in her to stop the light.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Hnnnggghhh...!
Noah falls to her knees. Her shield loses its light.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Ugh... This is kind of embarrassing...

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Not at all.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Like I said, you're really cool.
Neon steps in front of Noah.
The shield grows transparent. It's about to break.
Altruia's light starts seeping through.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Hey...

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Don't worry.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: I'm really tough.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: G-get out of the way. Have you lost your mind?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Of course not. I'm always level-headed.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Move!
There's a crack as Noah's shield breaks.
Neon pulls Noah to her right before she collapses.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: You've been the one protecting us. Now it's my turn to protect you.
Light surrounds the Admire.
The light begins to fade.
Only a dense cloud of dust washes over them.
The rolls and curves of the surface have been made flat.
Altruia shows her sincere condolences
to those she had just fought with.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: I pray that you will now be at peace.
*Whoosh!*
The Admire comes zipping out of the dust cloud.
The cratered armor looks as if it's reached its limit, and smoke spews from several places on deck,
but it doesn't reduce its speed or change its direction.
The Admire charges toward Altruia.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: ... Remarkable.

lines.speaker: helm_op
lines.text: Status report.

lines.speaker: mast_op_r
lines.text: Good news! We can still take another blow!

lines.speaker: anchor_op
lines.text: Yes. The Admire is still afloat.

lines.speaker: anchor_op
lines.text: She can move and shoot,

lines.speaker: anchor_op
lines.text: but probably only once.

lines.speaker: helm_op
lines.text: How are Noah and Neon?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: We're... all right.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: ... What are you? How'd you wind up with a body like that?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: My body's... very healthy. *Huff...*

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Ridiculous...

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Mast, Anchor. Let's do it.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Do what? Surrender?

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: Not that.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: You mean the Admire Special?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: The Admire Special. Let's do it.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: You can't be serious. I just came up with that as a joke...

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: You were joking? I thought it had a certain sense of adventure about it.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Adventure.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Right! Adventure!

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: All right! I'll do it perfectly! Just watch!

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I'll leave it to you. Anchor, get ready.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Ooh, sounds like they have a plan.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Hey, hey. You just sit down.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: It's okay. I'm fine.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Yeah, right. You look like you fell off a cliff. Go on, take a look at yourself.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: I'm trying not to.
The Admire keeps charging forward.
Altruia weeps.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: Ohhh... Do you really have no other option but to cling to a single ploy?

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: And that lack of options makes you all the more earnest...

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: But when you find out that the only choice left to you is meaningless... Ohhh...!

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: How sad. How utterly, terribly sad.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: I shall end this in a moment.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: That is sole mercy I can provide you.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: You were all splendid warriors.
Altruia raises her many hands in prayer again.
Dozens of shields appear in front of the Admire.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: You will feel no pain when you crash into these.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Now!

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Admire... Speeeeciaaaal!!!

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: Wowww.
*Rumble!*
Mast turns the key even harder.
The Admire changes direction abruptly.
It spins in a circle without slowing down, to the point where the ship is about to tip over.
The tilted ship's hull scrapes and slips on the ground.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Anchor!

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: Okay. Launching anchor.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: But don't get confused. I don't mean I'm launching myself.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Hahaha!
*Pshoo!*
A large anchor is launched from the Admire.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: ... What?!
Boom!
The anchor goes flying and hooks into Altruia's body.
*Rumble, rumble!*
Using Altruia as an axis, the Admire makes circles around her, scraping against the ground.
*Kkkrrk!*
Altruia is forced to carry the Admire's weight.
The wire attached to the anchor is so taut it might break.
The anchor moves around Altruia's body, tearing it to pieces.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: Ah... Ahh...!
As the Admire scrapes the ground in a circle,
they wind up perfectly behind Altruia.
On the deck of the Admire, which is tilting and shaking so much it's hard to stand,
the captain who had long dreamed of the surface shouts.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Admire! Standby!

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: No obstacles in the line of fire. Fire at will.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Aegis Cannon!

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Fire!

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Aye aye, Captain!
*Shwooom!*
Blue light stretches from the Admire's cannon.
*Boom!*
Still spinning around Altruia, they launch the Aegis Cannon.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: This... can't...!
Altruia's enormous torso goes flying.
Her black core is revealed,
and Neon and Noah start to sprint.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Let's go, Noah!

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: This again, huh?
They run along the wire connected to Altruia.
The wire shakes violently, but it poses no problem to the two of them.
They run up the wire without hesitation.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: She's coming out of the core!
At the end of the wire, they can see Altruia inside the broken black core.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: So that's how that works! The core was like a cockpit! That's amazing!

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Must be nice to be so easily impressed!

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: Don't... come any closer...!
Altruia fires a gold beam.
Noah's uses her shield to block it.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Wh-whoa!
The blow throws off Noah's balance on the shaking wire, and she wobbles.
Neon supports her back.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Let's go! Strongest shield on the surface!

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: You don't have to say that every time!
Noah runs. She stops all of Altruia's desperate attacks.
Her nose is bleeding, but she doesn't wipe it away.
She knows that what she has to do
is open the path for the strongest firepower on the surface.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Go! Strongest firepower on the surface!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Leave it to me!
They keep running, blocking all the golden light as they go.
Shields appear, trying to bounce them off,
but Noah pierces through them, and Neon jumps over them.
And...
*Clack*
... at the end of the wire, Neon aims her gun at Altruia.
Neon's gun ramps up,
and golden rings flare in Neon's eyes.
Gold light radiates both from her body and her gun.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: I'll give you a moment to pray.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: ... How merciful of you.
Altruia closes her eyes and brings her hands together.
Neon pulls the trigger.
There's a series of explosions mixed with gold particles.
The false saint crumbles and disappears.
Helm, Mast, and Anchor approach Neon and Noah where they lie sprawled on the ground.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Well done. That was remarkable.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Heh. Yeah, I know.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: You guys were incredible too.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: The Admire got completely wrecked, though...

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: But we won.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: We beat a Heretic.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: ... That we did. We more than proved ourselves.
Helm silently looks up at the Admire.
She gazes proudly at the battered ship.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: ... Finally.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Are you crying?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: No. It's still too early for that.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: Oh, the communication device isn't too damaged. It won't take long to fix.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Phew... Good. I nearly forgot about that.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Oh, right. Comms are down. We haven't been able to make a single call because of the jamming signal.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Yeah, we've got a communication device on the Admire.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: The jamming hurts us all in many more ways than one.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Does that mean we can make calls now?

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: There's an issue, so not right this moment, but we'll fix it up quickly.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Okay.
Neon springs to her feet.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: That'll help a lot.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: ... Neon.
Neon stares at the Goddess of Victory statue in the distance.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: I have to head over there.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: This isn't over yet.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Agh. We took down one of them, but the biggest one is still kicking.
Noah struggles to her feet.
She absentmindedly wipes the blood flowing from her nose.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Let's go, Firepower Four Eyes.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: No. You stay here.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: You could die if you keep going.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: What, you think this is that bad...?!
*Thud*
*Drip*
Noah falls helplessly to the ground, blood spilling from her nose.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: ... Ack.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Noah...
Neon kneels before her and wipes the blood with her sleeve.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: I can... still... fight...
Neon gently shakes her head.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Don't make Johan and Cecil mourn anyone else.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: When those two gave you a new body,

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: do you think it was for you to fight to the death on the battlefield?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: They want you to come back alive, and to keep living.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: That's why they gave it to you.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: So live.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Firepower Four Eyes...

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Shut... up... I'm... going... with...!
Noah tries to stand up but loses her balance and collapses.
Helm gently supports her from behind.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Hrngh...! Ugh...!
Noah glares at Neon with a tearful expression.
Neon looks at her and cries.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Don't worry. We're going to win.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: You'd... better...!
Noah passes out.
Helm looks her over.
She nods at Neon, who breathes a sigh of relief.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: We'll join you soon.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: ... At least, that's what we'd like to say...

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: It'd be a miracle if the Admire could even move right now.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: It's okay. Thanks to you, we destroyed Altroopia or whatever.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Don't push yourselves any harder.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Just leave the rest to us.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Oh, but I wouldn't say no to some encouraging applause.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: Clap, clap, clap.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: ... I'm sorry we couldn't help more.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: It's up to you now. And... I'm sorry, too.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Aw, you did plenty. Thanks.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Anyway, see you all later.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Yeah. See you later.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Make sure you win!

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: Bye-bye.
After saying her goodbyes, Neon limps away.
She soon gathers herself,
and starts slowly running.
